units: Constant 2023 EUR billion unless a rate is labelled
purpose: Conditional fiscal feasibility tests, not forecasts or proof of welfare gains

definitions.annualBalance: First annual financing-inclusive cost at or below zero
definitions.cumulativePayback: First undiscounted financing-inclusive cumulative cost at or below zero after positive costs
definitions.threshold: Required absolute NI real output growth, rounded upward to .01 percentage point for display. No confidence interval or estimated treatment effect is implied.

caveats: All study deductions and UK-retention assumptions are favourable negotiated terms, not settled liabilities.
The marginal revenue share is an assumption, not an estimated NI tax elasticity.
Gross baseline spending and receipts are constant in real terms in the examples. Sensitivity includes alternative common growth paths.
The selected output growth contains all assumed policy effects. No linked capital, consumption, employment or FDI dividends are stacked on it.
The historical output anchor, fiscal vintage and gross/net harmonisation boundary retain the documented evidence limitations.
No additional fund endowment, UK transition grant or EU transfer has been invented.
Annual fiscal balance and cumulative payback do not measure household welfare or all-island benefits.
